A permission scope is a scope named admin: and a permission of the server's staff (admin:manage_invites, to keep as it is); the reader can choose only those of the permissions their own account has, and no request on the page where people allow the app (the consent page) may ask for one, whoever allows.

settings.apps.token.disabled.defaultMessage: The server's administrators have disabled this app, so it gets no token until they enable it again.
settings.apps.token.disabled.description: A sentence in the place of the form on the page Issue token, for an app the server's administrators disabled.

settings.apps.token.issued.description: The sentence that heads the page that shows an access token and a refresh token right after the reader issued them. No full stop: it is a heading.

settings.apps.token.access.description: The name of the access token: the heading over it on the page that shows it once, and the name of that value for assistive technology. A developer's word (OAuth).

settings.apps.token.refresh.description: The name of the refresh token: the heading over it on the page that shows it once, and the name of that value for assistive technology. A developer's word (OAuth).

settings.apps.token.facts.defaultMessage: Its scopes are {scope}. The access token works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. The refresh token then gets a new pair, and works one time.
settings.apps.token.facts.description: Under settings.apps.token.issued, over the access token and the refresh token shown once. scope is the names of the scopes the token has, separated by spaces (read write:statuses); minutes is how long the access token works.

settings.apps.scope.admin.defaultMessage: Administer this server, within what your account may do
settings.apps.scope.admin.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope admin). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.admin).

settings.apps.scope.admin_read.defaultMessage: Read this server's administration data, within what your account may do
settings.apps.scope.admin_read.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope admin:read). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.admin_read).

settings.apps.scope.admin_write.defaultMessage: Change this server's administration data, within what your account may do
settings.apps.scope.admin_write.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope admin:write). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.admin_write).

settings.apps.scope.admin_permission.defaultMessage: Use the permission {permission} your account has
settings.apps.scope.admin_permission.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app, for a permission scope admin:<permission>. permission is the name of a permission of the server's staff, such as manage_invites. The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.admin_permission).

settings.apps.scope.follow.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope follow). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.follow).

settings.apps.scope.push.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope push). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.push).

settings.apps.scope.read.defaultMessage: Read your account, posts, and timelines
settings.apps.scope.read.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read).

settings.apps.scope.read_accounts.defaultMessage: Read accounts, your profile, and your settings
settings.apps.scope.read_accounts.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:accounts). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_accounts).

settings.apps.scope.read_blocks.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:blocks). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_blocks).

settings.apps.scope.read_bookmarks.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:bookmarks). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_bookmarks).

settings.apps.scope.read_custom_emojis.defaultMessage: Read the custom emoji you made and your requests for new ones
settings.apps.scope.read_custom_emojis.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:custom_emojis). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_custom_emojis).

settings.apps.scope.read_direct.defaultMessage: Read the direct messages you send and receive
settings.apps.scope.read_direct.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:direct). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_direct).

settings.apps.scope.read_events.defaultMessage: Read the events you can see
settings.apps.scope.read_events.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:events). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_events).

settings.apps.scope.read_favourites.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:favourites). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_favourites).

settings.apps.scope.read_filters.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:filters). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_filters).

settings.apps.scope.read_finance.defaultMessage: Read the totals of this server's costs and income, within what your account may do
settings.apps.scope.read_finance.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:finance). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_finance).

settings.apps.scope.read_follows.defaultMessage: Read your follows, follow requests, lists, and the accounts whose new posts notify you
settings.apps.scope.read_follows.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:follows). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_follows).

settings.apps.scope.read_mutes.defaultMessage: Read the accounts and domains you mute
settings.apps.scope.read_mutes.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:mutes). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_mutes).

settings.apps.scope.read_notifications.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:notifications). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_notifications).

settings.apps.scope.read_reports.defaultMessage: Read the reports you filed and whether they are resolved
settings.apps.scope.read_reports.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:reports). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_reports).

settings.apps.scope.read_statuses.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:statuses). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_statuses).

settings.apps.scope.read_supporters.defaultMessage: Read your subscription to the supporter plans
settings.apps.scope.read_supporters.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:supporters). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_supporters).

settings.apps.scope.read_voice.defaultMessage: Read the voice chat rooms you can see
settings.apps.scope.read_voice.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope read:voice). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.read_voice).

settings.apps.scope.write.defaultMessage: Post and change things for you
settings.apps.scope.write.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write).

settings.apps.scope.write_accounts.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:accounts). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_accounts).

settings.apps.scope.write_blocks.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:blocks). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_blocks).

settings.apps.scope.write_bookmarks.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:bookmarks). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_bookmarks).

settings.apps.scope.write_custom_emojis.defaultMessage: Request new custom emoji, and change and delete the ones you made
settings.apps.scope.write_custom_emojis.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:custom_emojis). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_custom_emojis).

settings.apps.scope.write_events.defaultMessage: Create, change, and cancel events, answer them, and invite people to them
settings.apps.scope.write_events.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:events). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_events).

settings.apps.scope.write_favourites.defaultMessage: Add and remove favourites and emoji reactions
settings.apps.scope.write_favourites.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:favourites). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_favourites).

settings.apps.scope.write_filters.defaultMessage: Create, change, and delete your keyword filters
settings.apps.scope.write_filters.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:filters). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_filters).

settings.apps.scope.write_follows.defaultMessage: Follow and unfollow accounts, answer follow requests, change lists, and subscribe to the new posts of accounts
settings.apps.scope.write_follows.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:follows). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_follows).

settings.apps.scope.write_media.defaultMessage: Upload images, videos, and audio, and edit their descriptions
settings.apps.scope.write_media.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:media). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_media).

settings.apps.scope.write_mutes.defaultMessage: Mute and unmute accounts, domains, and threads
settings.apps.scope.write_mutes.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:mutes). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_mutes).

settings.apps.scope.write_notifications.defaultMessage: Mark notifications as read and dismiss them
settings.apps.scope.write_notifications.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:notifications). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_notifications).

settings.apps.scope.write_reports.defaultMessage: Report accounts and posts to the moderators
settings.apps.scope.write_reports.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:reports). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_reports).

settings.apps.scope.write_statuses.defaultMessage: Post, edit, delete, boost, and pin posts, vote in polls, and set who may quote a post
settings.apps.scope.write_statuses.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:statuses). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_statuses).

settings.apps.scope.write_supporters.defaultMessage: Subscribe to the supporter plans, and change, cancel, and resume your subscription
settings.apps.scope.write_supporters.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:supporters). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_supporters).

settings.apps.scope.write_voice.defaultMessage: Open, join, and leave voice chat rooms, and host them
settings.apps.scope.write_voice.description: A permission on the page of an authorized app (the scope write:voice). The same words as the consent page's (server:auth.authorize.scope.write_voice).

settings.invites.own.description: A section heading on the Invites page of the settings, over the list of the invites the reader created; also the name of that list for assistive technology, and the title of an invite's page until the invite is read.

settings.invites.own.about.defaultMessage: A person signs up with an invite's link, or enters its code on the sign-up page.
settings.invites.own.about.description: The line under the heading Your invites: how an invite is used. An invite has a code and a link that holds the code; the sign-up page has a field named Invite code (auth.sign_up.invite_label).

settings.invites.none.defaultMessage: {may, select, yes {You have no invites yet. Create one to get a link for the person you invite.} other {You have no invites.}}
settings.invites.none.description: In the place of the list of the reader's invites while it is empty. may is yes for a reader who may create an invite, over the button Create invite, and other for a reader who may not, under the summary that says why (settings.invites.cannot).

settings.invites.create.description: The button on the Invites page that opens the page where the reader creates an invite; the title of that page, and the button at its end that creates the invite.

settings.invites.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, usable {Usable until {date}} revoked {Revoked} expired {Expired {date}} exhausted {Used up} registration_closed {Not usable while sign-ups are closed} other {Not usable while you cannot create invites}}
settings.invites.state.description: The first muted line of an invite's row in the list Your invites, and the name of the row under Status on the invite's page: what the invite allows now. state is usable (people can sign up with it until date), revoked (the reader revoked it), expired (it ended at date), exhausted (as many people signed up with it as it allows), registration_closed (the server takes no new accounts now, so nobody can sign up with the invite until it does again), or other (the reader may not create invites now, so the invite does not work until they may again). date is a day and an hour (Nov 25, 3 PM). Not a sentence: no full stop.

settings.invites.uses.defaultMessage: Used {uses, number} of {max, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
settings.invites.uses.description: A muted line of an invite's row, under its state: uses is how many people signed up with the invite, max how many it allows. Not a sentence: no full stop.

settings.invites.ends.description: A muted line of an invite's row, for an invite that does not work for now (while the reader may not create invites, or while the server takes no new accounts): when the invite expires, whether it works again before that or not. The word of the state Expired (settings.invites.state), so that it is not read as the day the server takes new accounts again. date is a day and an hour (Nov 25, 3 PM). Not a sentence: no full stop.

settings.invites.left.defaultMessage: You can create {left, plural, one {# more invite} other {# more invites}}. You can have {max, plural, one {# usable invite} other {# usable invites}} at a time.
settings.invites.left.description: A sentence in the section Your invites when the reader is one invite short of the most usable invites the server allows: left is how many more they can create (1), max the most usable invites one account may have at once.

settings.invites.full.defaultMessage: {max, plural, =0 {This server does not let users create invites now.} other {You have as many usable invites as allowed (#). Revoke one, or wait until one expires or is used up.}}
settings.invites.full.description: A sentence in the section Your invites, in place of the button Create invite, and on the page Create invite in the form's place, when the reader has as many usable invites as the server allows. max is that number; 0 means the server's administrators let no user create invites for now. The same words as the server's refusal (errors.invites.too_many), with the number.

settings.invites.cannot.description: The title of the summary at the top of the Invites page, and of the page Create invite, for a reader who may not create invites now; settings.invites.cannot.reason under it says why. The words of the server's refusal (errors.invites.not_allowed), without its full stop: it is a heading.

settings.invites.cannot.reason.defaultMessage: {reason, select, registration_closed {This server takes no new accounts now, so no invite can be created.} not_permitted {Only some accounts can create invites on this server. Ask its administrators to let you create them.} not_approved {Your registration is not approved. A moderator needs to approve it before you can create invites.} restricted {A moderation action keeps your account from creating invites for now. To see why or to appeal, open “Account status” under “Account and data” in the settings.} other {You cannot create invites now.}}
settings.invites.cannot.reason.description: Under the title You cannot create invites (settings.invites.cannot): why the reader may not create invites now. reason is registration_closed (the server takes no new accounts), not_permitted (the server lets only some accounts create invites), not_approved (the registration of the account is pending or rejected), or restricted (a moderation action on the account); any other value names no cause. The same sentences as the server's refusal (errors.invites.not_allowed_detail), which the list of invites gives only as the reason's name.

settings.invites.link.description: A section heading on the page of a usable invite, and on the page Create invite once the invite is created, over the invite's link shown to copy; also the name of that link for assistive technology.

settings.invites.link.about.defaultMessage: Send this link to the person you invite. They can also enter the invite code {code} on the sign-up page.
settings.invites.link.about.description: The line under the heading Invite link on an invite's page, and under the title The invite is created (settings.invites.created) once one is created: what to do with the link. code is the invite's code, 16 letters and digits, which the sign-up page takes in its field Invite code (auth.sign_up.invite_label); it is not translated.

settings.invites.copy.description: The button under an invite's link, which copies the link.

settings.invites.status.description: A section heading on an invite's page, over what the invite allows now (settings.invites.state) and how often it was used; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.invites.revoke.heading.description: A section heading on the page of an invite that works, or would work again, over the row that revokes it; also the name of that list for assistive technology.

settings.invites.revoke.row.description: The name of the row in the section Revoke invite: what revoking gives.

settings.invites.revoke.about.defaultMessage: Its link and its code stop working at once, and this cannot be undone. People who signed up with it keep their accounts.
settings.invites.revoke.about.description: The line under settings.invites.revoke.row, and the text of the confirmation under settings.invites.revoke.title: what stops working, that it cannot be undone, and what stays.

settings.invites.revoke.title.description: The title of the confirmation before an invite is revoked. code is the invite's code, 16 letters and digits; it is not translated.

settings.invites.revoke.description: The button at the end of the row settings.invites.revoke.row, which asks before revoking the invite; and the button of that confirmation (settings.invites.revoke.title).

settings.invites.new.heading.description: A section heading on the page Create invite, over the two settings of the invite: how many people can sign up with it, and how long it works.

settings.invites.new.uses.description: The label of a number field on the page Create invite: how many people can sign up with the invite.

settings.invites.new.uses.about.description: The line under the label People who can sign up: max is the most people the server allows for one invite.

settings.invites.new.life.description: The label of a choice on the page Create invite: how long the invite works, from when it is created. Its options are lengths of time (settings.invites.new.life.option): Works for, 7 days.

settings.invites.new.life.option.defaultMessage: {unit, select, days {{count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} hours {{count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}} other {{count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}
settings.invites.new.life.option.description: An option of the choice Works for on the page Create invite: a length of time. unit is days, hours, or other (minutes); count is how many of them.

settings.invites.new.refused.defaultMessage: {field, select, max_uses {This server no longer allows that many people for one invite. Enter a smaller number and create the invite again.} other {This server no longer allows an invite to work that long. Choose a shorter time and create the invite again.}}
settings.invites.new.refused.description: An alert before the button Create invite when the server refused the invite because a value is over what it allows now: its administrators lowered a limit after the page was opened, and the page then shows the new limits. field is max_uses (too many people) or other (too long a time).

settings.invites.created.description: The title of the summary that heads the page Create invite once the invite is created, which takes the focus as the form gives way to it; the line under it says what to do with the invite's link (settings.invites.link.about), shown under it to copy. No full stop: it is a heading.

settings.invites.missing.defaultMessage: This invite is not among your invites. Check the address.
settings.invites.missing.description: In place of an invite's page of the settings at an address that names no invite of the reader's. The link to the Invites page follows it on the same line (settings.invites.missing.all).

settings.invites.missing.all.description: The link after settings.invites.missing that opens the Invites page of the settings.

settings.voice.hosted.description: The heading of the list of the voice chat rooms the reader hosted, on the Voice chat page of the settings; also the list's name.

settings.voice.hosted.about.defaultMessage: The rooms you opened or took over, newest first.
settings.voice.hosted.about.description: Under the heading of the rooms the reader hosted, in the settings.

settings.voice.none.defaultMessage: You have not hosted a room yet.
settings.voice.none.description: In place of the rooms the reader hosted, in the settings, while there are none.

settings.voice.ended.defaultMessage: {reason, select, host {The host ended it} empty {Ended when everyone left} host_disconnected {Ended when the host lost the connection} host_ineligible {Ended when the host could no longer open rooms} moderator {A moderator ended it} time_limit {Ended at its time limit} disabled {Ended when voice chat was turned off} host_absent {Ended when the host did not come} other {Ended when no one came}}
settings.voice.ended.description: Where a voice chat room the reader hosted stands, in the settings, once it ended: reason is why (host, empty, host_disconnected, host_ineligible, moderator, time_limit, disabled, host_absent, or other: unattended).

settings.voice.opened_at.description: A fact of a voice chat room the reader hosted, in the settings: date is when it opened, its day and hour.

settings.voice.ended_at.description: A fact of a voice chat room the reader hosted, in the settings: date is when it ended, its day and hour.

settings.events.loading.description: In place of the settings of events while the reminders load.

settings.events.failed.defaultMessage: Your reminders could not be loaded.
settings.events.failed.description: In place of the settings of events when the reminders could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

settings.events.reminders.description: The heading of the reminders before events in the settings.

settings.events.reminders.about.defaultMessage: A notification before each event you answered going or maybe.
settings.events.reminders.about.description: The line under the heading of the reminders before events in the settings.

settings.events.reminder.description: The name of one of the three choices of a reminder before events in the settings.

settings.events.before.defaultMessage: {unit, select, day {{count, plural, one {# day before} other {# days before}}} hour {{count, plural, one {# hour before} other {# hours before}}} other {{count, plural, one {# minute before} other {# minutes before}}}}
settings.events.before.description: How long before an event's start a reminder is, a choice of a reminder in the settings.

settings.events.none.description: The choice of no reminder in one of the three choices of a reminder before events.

settings.events.defaults.description: The button under the reminders before events that brings back the defaults (1 day and 1 hour before, which the line about the section does not spell out).

settings.events.defaults_done.description: Beside the button that brings back the default reminders once it did.

settings.supporter.loading.description: In the Supporter screen's place while the reader's subscription is read.

settings.supporter.failed.defaultMessage: Your subscription could not be loaded.
settings.supporter.failed.description: In the Supporter screen's place when the reader's subscription could not be read; Try again follows.

settings.supporter.tip.description: The heading of the section of the Supporter screen that leads to tipping the server.

settings.supporter.tip.caption.description: Under Tip the server in the Supporter screen.

settings.supporter.tip.limited.later.defaultMessage: You started too many tips. Try again later.
settings.supporter.tip.limited.later.description: Before Tip when the server limits how often a tip starts and says no wait.

settings.supporter.tip.refused.defaultMessage: {kind, select, tip_amount {This amount is no longer offered. Choose another.} tip_pending {Another tip is starting. Wait a moment, then try again.} tips_unavailable {Tips cannot be paid right now. Try again later.} closing {This server is closing, so it takes no tips.} ineligible {Your account cannot tip now. Reload the page to see why.} other {This could not be done. Try again.}}
settings.supporter.tip.refused.description: Before Tip when the server refused to start a tip ({kind}: why).

settings.supporter.tip.returned.description: The heading of what came of the tip the reader came back from, when it could not be read.

settings.supporter.tip.returned.failed.defaultMessage: What came of your tip could not be loaded. Reload the page later.
settings.supporter.tip.returned.failed.description: When the tip the reader came back from the checkout of could not be read.

settings.supporter.tip.result.defaultMessage: {result, select, paid {Thank you for your tip of {amount}} unpaid {Your tip was not paid} settling {Your tip of {amount} is being confirmed} other {This tip could not be found}}
settings.supporter.tip.result.description: The title of what came of the tip the reader came back from ({result}; {amount}: the tip's amount).

settings.supporter.tip.result.about.defaultMessage: {result, select, paid {It goes to the people who run {server}.} unpaid {Nothing was charged. You can tip again below.} settling {This page updates once the payment goes through.} other {Nothing more is known of it here.}}
settings.supporter.tip.result.about.description: Under the title of what came of the tip ({server}: the server's name).

settings.supporter.tip.loading.description: In the tip screen's place while the operator's amounts are read.

settings.supporter.tip.failed.defaultMessage: The amounts could not be loaded.
settings.supporter.tip.failed.description: In the tip screen's place when the amounts could not be read; Try again follows.

settings.supporter.tip.pay.description: The tip screen's primary button: it starts a tip of the amount chosen and leaves for the payment provider's checkout.

settings.supporter.tip.off.defaultMessage: This server takes no tips now.
settings.supporter.tip.off.description: The tip screen of a server that takes no tips.

settings.supporter.tip.amount.description: The heading of the choice of a tip's amount, and the choice's name.

settings.supporter.tip.once.defaultMessage: Starting a tip ends any tip payment page you left open, so you pay only once.
settings.supporter.tip.once.description: Under the amounts of a tip: one tip is open at a time.

settings.supporter.tip.limited.defaultMessage: You started too many tips. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
settings.supporter.tip.limited.description: Before Tip when the server limits how often a tip starts ({minutes}: how long to wait).

settings.supporter.returned.canceled.defaultMessage: You left the payment page. Nothing was charged.
settings.supporter.returned.canceled.description: Said in the Supporter screen when the reader came back from the payment provider's checkout without paying.

settings.supporter.returned.settling.defaultMessage: Your payment is being confirmed. This page updates once it goes through.
settings.supporter.returned.settling.description: Said in the Supporter screen when the reader came back from the checkout and the payment has not settled yet.

settings.supporter.returned.paid.defaultMessage: Thank you. You support this server on {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}}.
settings.supporter.returned.paid.description: Said in the Supporter screen when the reader came back from the checkout and the payment went through ({plan}: the plan's name).

settings.supporter.portal.ended.defaultMessage: The payment provider has no subscription of yours. Reload the page to see where it stands.
settings.supporter.portal.ended.description: Said in the Supporter screen when the payment provider's portal cannot open: it knows no subscription of the reader.

settings.supporter.state.renewing.description: The state of an active subscription: when it renews ({date}, a day with its year).

settings.supporter.state.ending.description: The state of a cancelled subscription: when it ends ({date}).

settings.supporter.state.failed.defaultMessage: Your payment failed: update your payment method before {date}, or your perks end then
settings.supporter.state.failed.description: The state of a subscription whose payment failed, in its 7 days of grace ({date}: when the grace ends).

settings.supporter.state.lapsed.defaultMessage: Your payment failed, and your perks have ended
settings.supporter.state.lapsed.description: The state of a subscription whose payment failed and whose grace ended: the role is gone until a payment goes through.

settings.supporter.state.pending.defaultMessage: Your subscription to {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}}, waits for its first payment of {price}.
settings.supporter.state.pending.description: The state of a subscription whose first payment is not made yet ({plan}: the plan's name; {price}: what the first payment charges, the price of the plan at its period).

settings.supporter.state.changing.defaultMessage: Changes to {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}}, on {date}
settings.supporter.state.changing.description: The state of a subscription whose change to another plan or period waits for the period's end ({plan}: the new plan's name).

settings.supporter.resume.description: The button beside a cancelled subscription that takes the cancellation back.

settings.supporter.resumed.defaultMessage: Your subscription goes on. It renews on {date}.
settings.supporter.resumed.description: Said once a cancelled subscription was resumed ({date}: when it renews).

settings.supporter.update_payment.description: The button beside a failed payment that leaves for the payment provider's portal, where the reader changes the card.

settings.supporter.none.defaultMessage: You do not support this server with a plan.
settings.supporter.none.description: In the reader's subscription's place while they have none.

settings.supporter.portal.description: The button of the Supporter screen that leaves for the payment provider's portal of payment methods and invoices.

settings.supporter.cancel.description: The button that asks before cancelling the subscription at its period's end, and the confirmation of that question.

settings.supporter.cancel.open.description: The last button of the reader's subscription: it asks before cancelling at the period's end (the question's own button is Cancel subscription).

settings.supporter.cancel.title.description: The question before cancelling the subscription.

settings.supporter.cancel.keep.description: The button of the question before cancelling that keeps the subscription.

settings.supporter.cancel.text.defaultMessage: You are not charged again. It ends on {date}, and your perks stay until then. You can resume it until that day.
settings.supporter.cancel.text.description: What cancelling does, in the question before it ({date}: the period's end).

settings.supporter.cancel.scheduled.defaultMessage: The change to {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}}, scheduled for then is cancelled too.
settings.supporter.cancel.scheduled.description: In the question before cancelling, after what cancelling does, when a change to another plan or period waits for the period's end ({plan}: that plan's name).

settings.supporter.canceled.description: Said once the subscription was cancelled ({date}: the period's end).

settings.supporter.plans.door.defaultMessage: {change, select, yes {Change your plan} other {See the plans}}
settings.supporter.plans.door.description: The row that leads to the plans on the supporters' page ({change}: yes for a reader whose subscription may change).

settings.supporter.plans.door.caption.defaultMessage: {change, select, yes {Another plan, or another billing period} other {Subscribe on the supporters' page}}
settings.supporter.plans.door.caption.description: Under the row that leads to the plans.

settings.supporter.listing.description: The heading of the reader's choice to be on the supporters list.

settings.supporter.listing.label.description: The switch of the reader's choice to be on the supporters list.

settings.supporter.listing.about.defaultMessage: {audience, select, everyone {Anyone can see the list, with you under your plan.} other {People signed in to this server can see the list, with you under your plan.}}
settings.supporter.listing.about.description: Under the switch of the reader's choice to be on the supporters list ({audience}: who may read the list).

settings.supporter.detail.price.defaultMessage: {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}} · {price} {interval, select, month {a month} other {a year}}
settings.supporter.detail.price.description: Under the state of a subscription that renews: its plan, period and price ({price}: what it renews at).

settings.supporter.detail.changing.defaultMessage: {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}} · {now} {interval, select, month {a month} other {a year}} until then, {price} {after, select, month {a month} other {a year}} after
settings.supporter.detail.changing.description: Under the state of a subscription whose change waits for the period's end: the plan now, its price until then ({now}), and the price after ({price}, at the period {after}).

settings.supporter.detail.ending.defaultMessage: {plan}, {interval, select, month {monthly} other {yearly}} · {price} {interval, select, month {a month} other {a year}} · Your perks stay until then.
settings.supporter.detail.ending.description: Under the state of a cancelled subscription that ends at its period's end: its plan, period and price.

settings.supporter.kept.description: Said once the change that waited for the period's end was cancelled.
